recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Isaiah Hartenstein was excellent tonight despite the loss. 20 PTS 10-14 FG 11 REB 6 AST 2 STL
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Thunder on the losing end tonight but thought it was an impressive response to last night's blowout. No Ajay Mitchell in addition to all the other injuries and OKC kept it close. High energy and effort all game. Some tough calls and some tough Blazers shots late. Schedule is
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Thunder have had Bennett Stirtz, Jared McCain and Kenrich Williams each dive on the floor in the last 2 possessions. This team is fighting.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Nique Clifford hits the first 3 pointer of his Thunder career and ties the game up. 88-88. Stirtz gets his 3rd steal of the game and dives to keep it in bounds. Kenrich layup. Thunder up 90-88. No matter who is on the court, this OKC team stays competing.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 16 points in the 3rd quarter. Blazers were up by 12. But SGA, Caruso and Hartenstein keeping OKC in this one. Thunder down 85-88. 12 minutes to go.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has 20+ points in 10 straight games. SGA's new streak hits double digits.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Alex Caruso has been excellent on both ends tonight. Caruso is 4-5 from 3. The rest of the team is 3-19 from 3. AC is a big reason why OKC is still in this one.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Alex Caruso steals the ball and goes down and hits a contested 3 pointer before the 1st half buzzer. OKC needed that one after a big Blazers run. Thunder down 50-56 at halftime.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Aday Mara continues his streak of at least 1 block in every game of his NBA career. 12 for 12.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Looked like Stirtz might’ve got fouled on his 3 attempt with no call. Then Caruso looks like he got hit with an illegal screen. No call. Blazers hit a 3 with Caruso on the floor. Caruso stayed down for a minute. Stays in the game. Tech on Daigneault.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Bennett Stirtz has 2 steals and takes a charge on Scoot. 3 turnovers caused by the rookie in 10 minutes.

recent.text: McCain hit a three to make it 69-67 OKC with 8:30 left in the 3Q. it’s been Blazers 32-15 since.

recent.text: Damian Lillard hits a logo 3 over Aday Mara's 7'6" wingspan at the 3rd quarter buzzer. Dame and the Blazers caught fire in the 3rd. A halftime tie turns into a 17 point Blazers lead. OKC: 5-16 3PT Blazers: 15-38 3PT
